nodes.name: build-pcb-model.mjs
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env node // Bakes a tscircuit Circuit JSON export into a self-contained glTF binary for // the web 3D viewer. Run by hand whenever the board changes: // // node scripts/build-pcb-model.mjs // node scripts/build-pcb-model.mjs ../FieldCam/hardware/dist/index/circuit.json // // The default source is the latest `tsci build` output from the hardware // workspace, which tracks hardware/index.tsx. The output is committed to // static/models so builds and CI never need the hardware workspace or the // converter's WASM dependencies. import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path"; import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url"; import { convertCircuitJsonToGltf } from "circuit-json-to-gltf"; const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), ".."); const source = resolve( process.argv[2] ?? resolve(root, "../FieldCam/hardware/dist/index/circuit.json"), ); const output = resolve(root, "static/models/fieldcam.glb"); const circuitJson = JSON.parse(await readFile(source, "utf8")); const glb = await convertCircuitJsonToGltf(circuitJson, { format: "glb", boardTextureResolution: 2048, backgroundColor: "#1F4A2C", boardSideColor: "#0E2415", copperColor: "#C8A961", silkscreenColor: "#F4F4F0", }); const buffer = Buffer.from(glb); const gltf = JSON.parse( buffer.subarray(20, 20 + buffer.readUInt32LE(12)).toString("utf8"), ); // The converter degrades silently when the SVG rasteriser is unavailable: // the board renders as flat colour with no silkscreen or copper. if ((gltf.images?.length ?? 0) < 2) { throw new Error( "board textures missing from the export (is @resvg/resvg-js installed?)", ); } await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true }); await writeFile(output, buffer); const size = (buffer.length / 1_000_000).toFixed(2); console.log( `baked ${source}\n -> ${output} (${size} MB, ${gltf.nodes.length} nodes, ${gltf.meshes.length} meshes, ${gltf.images.length} textures)`, );

nodes.name: hooks.server.js
nodes.body_text: import { redirect } from "@sveltejs/kit"; const TARGET = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saravenpi/dotfiles/main/install.sh"; const REDIRECTS = new Set([ "/install", "/install.sh", "/dotfiles", "/dotfiles.sh", ]);

nodes.name: handle
nodes.body_text: function handle({ event, resolve }) { const path = event.url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, ""); if (REDIRECTS.has(path) || REDIRECTS.has(event.url.pathname)) { redirect(307, TARGET); } return resolve(event); }

nodes.name: +page.js
nodes.body_text: import { error } from "@sveltejs/kit"; const posts = import.meta.glob("../../../posts/*.md");

nodes.name: load
nodes.body_text: async function load({ params }) { if (!params.slug) { throw error(404, `No slug provided`); } const postPath = `../../../posts/${params.slug}.md`; if (!posts[postPath]) { throw error(404, `Could not find ${params.slug}`); } try { const post = await posts[postPath](); return { content: post.default, meta: post.metadata, }; } catch (e) { console.error(`Failed to load post: ${params.slug}`, e); throw error(404, `Could not find ${params.slug}`); } }
